result.summary: Found 1 issue: a minor styling inconsistency with delivery time badges that appear to float awkwardly over restaurant cards.

issues.description: Delivery time badges (e.g., '15-25 min', '20-30 min') have white backgrounds that create a stark contrast and appear to float awkwardly over restaurant card images instead of being integrated into the card design.
issues.suggestion: Style the delivery time badges to better match the card design, perhaps using a semi-transparent background or placing them in a consistent corner with proper padding to look like an integrated part of the card rather than an overlay.
